from app.repositories.customers import get_customer
from app.repositories.orders import get_order
from app.services.fulfillment import allocate
from app.services.payment import capture_payment
from app.services.pricing import checkout_total, subtotal
from app.services.shipping import shipping_fee, shipment_status

def order_summary(order_id):
    order = get_order(order_id)
    customer = get_customer(order['customer_id'])
    items = order['items']
    base = subtotal(items)
    return {
        'order_id': order_id,
        'total': checkout_total(customer, items),
        'shipping_fee': shipping_fee(customer, base),
        'shipment_status': shipment_status(order_id),
    }

def process_order(order_id):
    order = get_order(order_id)
    customer = get_customer(order['customer_id'])
    total = checkout_total(customer, order['items'])
    allocation = allocate(order['items'])
    payment_status = capture_payment(order_id, total)
    return {'allocation': allocation, 'payment_status': payment_status}
